summary: BMO Financial Group files Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a definitive agreement to sell its Transportation Finance and Vendor Finance businesses to Stonepeak. The businesses comprise a combined loan and lease portfolio of approximately C$14.5 billion as of March 31, 2026. BMO will retain a 19.9% equity interest in the businesses post-sale, enabling continued participation in long-term value creation. The transaction is described as accretive to capital ratios and ROE, aligning with BMO's strategy to sharpen focus on core markets and improve capital efficiency. No purchase price, premium, board recommendation, or advisors are named in the press release. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions; watch for regulatory clearance timelines and any competing bids. Risk-arb angle: structural equity interest reduces downside, but regulatory hurdles could delay close.
